info.name: CrashCart observed sandbox API verification
info.description: Read-only verification export. Local smoke proves health and fixture only. Observed sandbox evidence requires an explicitly selected real paid run and independent provider retrieval. It does not initiate a payment, replay a regression, or turn stored evidence into fresh sandbox execution. CC-050 remains unverified until this actual collection passes against approved real observations.

item.name: Local smoke
item.description: No credentials or payment calls. A pass establishes only API/database health and the fixed merchant fixture.

exec: pm.test("API and actual database are healthy", () => {pm.expect(body.status).to.eql("ok"); pm.expect(body.database).to.eql("ok");});
pm.test("Owned workshop fixture identity is fixed", () => pm.expect(body.id).to.eql("workshop-v1"));

item.name: Observed sandbox evidence
item.description: Select an existing approved, captured and independently reconciled sandbox run. Missing token, run or proof makes this folder fail; no integration assertions are skipped. Requests are GET only.

exec: pm.test("Explicit observed run ID is required", () => pm.expect(pm.environment.get("run_id"), "Set run_id to an existing actual sandbox run").to.match(/^run_[a-zA-Z0-9]+$/));
pm.test("Operator token must be configured privately", () => pm.expect(pm.environment.get("operator_token"), "Set operator_token in a private environment").to.be.a("string").and.not.eql(""));
pm.test("Selected actual sandbox run responds HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("Stored run matches selection and actual sandbox mode", () => {pm.expect(run.id).to.eql(pm.environment.get("run_id")); pm.expect(["LIVE_SANDBOX", "FRESH_SANDBOX"]).to.include(run.mode);});

pm.test("Run, logical purchase and merchant identities correlate", () => {pm.expect(purchase.run_id).to.eql(run.id); pm.expect(run.purchase_id).to.eql(purchase.id); pm.expect(merchant.purchase_id).to.eql(purchase.id); pm.expect(merchant.run_id).to.eql(run.id); pm.expect(merchant.order_id).to.eql(purchase.order_id);});

const reads = (Array.isArray(body.events) ? body.events : []).filter(event => event.source === "provider" && event.event_type === "independent_order_read" && event.run_id === run.id && event.purchase_id === purchase.id && event.order_id === purchase.order_id && event.payload && event.payload.id === purchase.order_id);
pm.test("Independent provider retrieval event exists", () => pm.expect(reads.length, "A stored top-level success label is insufficient").to.be.above(0));

pm.test("Retrieved completed order contains one correlated purchase unit", () => {pm.expect(order.id).to.eql(purchase.order_id); pm.expect(order.status).to.eql("COMPLETED"); pm.expect(order.intent).to.eql("CAPTURE"); pm.expect(units).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(unit.reference_id).to.eql(purchase.id); pm.expect(unit.custom_id).to.eql(purchase.id); pm.expect(unit.amount).to.deep.eql({currency_code:"USD", value:"29.00"});});

pm.test("Independent nested capture confirms exact amount and identity", () => {pm.expect(captures).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(capture.id).to.eql(purchase.capture_id); pm.expect(capture.status).to.eql("COMPLETED"); pm.expect(capture.amount).to.deep.eql({currency_code:"USD", value:"29.00"}); pm.expect(capture.update_time).to.eql(purchase.capture_completed_at); pm.expect(Number.isFinite(Date.parse(capture.update_time))).to.eql(true); pm.expect(Date.parse(read.observed_at)).to.be.at.least(Date.parse(capture.update_time));});

pm.test("Logical capture journal matches the independently observed order", () => {const operations = (body.operations || []).filter(operation => operation.semantic_key === "order.capture" && operation.purchase_id === purchase.id); pm.expect(operations).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(operations[0].request_id).to.be.a("string").and.not.eql("");});
pm.test("An explicit expected ticket count is supplied", () => pm.expect(expected).to.match(/^[0-9]+$/));

pm.test("Actual merchant count matches the chosen experiment", () => {pm.expect(merchant.known).to.eql(true); pm.expect(merchant.ticket_count).to.eql(Number(expected)); pm.expect(merchant.tickets).to.have.lengthOf(Number(expected)); for (const ticket of merchant.tickets) {pm.expect(ticket.purchase_id).to.eql(purchase.id); pm.expect(ticket.id).to.be.a("string").and.not.eql("");}});

if (typeof purchase.id === "string" && typeof purchase.order_id === "string" && typeof purchase.capture_id === "string") {pm.collectionVariables.set("selected_purchase_id", purchase.id); pm.collectionVariables.set("selected_order_id", purchase.order_id); pm.collectionVariables.set("selected_capture_id", purchase.capture_id);}
pm.test("Read-only merchant adapter responds HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test("Merchant adapter retains selected run and payment correlation", () => {pm.expect(body.known).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.run_id).to.eql(pm.environment.get("run_id")); pm.expect(body.purchase_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("selected_purchase_id")); pm.expect(body.order_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("selected_order_id"));});

pm.test("Stored usable tickets match the explicit expected count", () => {const expected = Number(pm.environment.get("expected_ticket_count")); pm.expect(body.ticket_count).to.eql(expected); pm.expect(body.tickets).to.have.lengthOf(expected); for (const ticket of body.tickets) {pm.expect(ticket.purchase_id).to.eql(body.purchase_id); pm.expect(ticket.id).to.be.a("string").and.not.eql("");}});
